Ruling record for this card: the maintainer's words that order this rule into the skill text. Transcribed by the seat that filed the card. The reading at the end is the seat's.

- Who: the maintainer (Sales), in the project's cost-review thread.
- The question, verbatim and untranslated: 「p1，安全卡只是优先级，不代表复杂度，为什么一定要不进区？」
  - When: 2026-11-20T07:42:03Z.
- The choice, made on a decision card asked in that thread at 2026-11-20T07:44:37Z, verbatim and untranslated:
  - Question: 「定一下 p1 和安全卡要不要一律单开线程」
  - Option chosen: 「只看大小,p1 只管先后」, whose stated consequence reads 「S 卡用子代理,M 卡有区进区,大卡才一卡一线程;有披露纪律的安全卡仍留座位。要立卡改技能这一行。」
  - The other option, not chosen: 「维持一律单开线程」
  - Source of the choice: the coordinator's relay to the seat at 2026-11-20T07:45:32Z, which quotes the question verbatim and names the option picked. The seat read the card's text directly.

Reading taken by the seat: whether a card gets its own thread follows its size and shape only. S cards run as a sub-agent in the seat or an area; M cards go into an area when one fits, else a thread; big cards (L/XL, owing full verification, contract-changing) keep one thread each; security cards under disclosure discipline stay in the seat session. p1 sets order only. This ruling covers the routing lines this card names. It orders no byte-ceiling raise.
